opening.argument: The speaker promotes Mirror Trading International as a Bitcoin trading opportunity operated through an artificial-intelligence trading bot, stating that "they trade for you" and that he put "$200 into it" while it made money daily from Monday through Friday. He emphasizes that the money is "compounding" and "always growing," presenting the contribution as a path to recurring returns. Participation also requires viewers to obtain Bitcoin and a wallet, place it "into the pool," and reach out to join. These linked financial instructions and claimed compounding weekday earnings establish the promoted opportunity as a trading-return scheme. The available evidence does not establish that contributions or returns actually occurred or explain how the service operated beyond his description.
